property.name: hint_text
property.value: The Choir's gaolers. Your mantras will not answer here.

property.name: hint_text
property.value: Something huge listens in the dark. Move softly.

property.name: hint_text
property.value: Ether seeps up through the bones.

property.name: hint_text
property.value: Seven tally marks, cut deep into the stone. Someone counted something here. Someone counted you.

property.name: hint_text
property.value: Three rings of black iron bite into your wrists. Where the Eye's mantras used to answer, there is only silence.

property.name: hint_text
property.value: 'You carry it, then. The Choir nearly has what it wants. Three anchors hold your chains, boy - below, in the Archive, the Wards and the drowned ossuary. Break them before they break you.'

property.name: hint_text
property.value: 'Each anchor guards one piece of who you were. Go in whatever order you like - the dead have time.'

property.name: hint_text
property.value: Candidate VII. Given name: struck out. Entrusted to House Corwen, pending the Naming.

property.name: hint_text
property.value: A letter, never sent on: 'Give me back my son. You may keep your prophecy.'

property.name: hint_text
property.value: Carved below the waterline: 'The prophecy was written in Absalom's own hand, in the year he founded the Choir.'

property.name: hint_text
property.value: Three chains hold the Seal Gate. Each runs down into a different dark.

property.name: hint_text
property.value: The Naming Altar. Six names are carved here, and six are struck out. The seventh is still waiting.

property.name: locked_text
property.value: The ritual still holds the stair shut.

property.name: depart_text
property.value: You follow the Eye's light down, toward the heat of the Forge.

property.name: hint
property.value: The cell door is rusted, but the lock looks old.

property.name: text
property.value: A bent nail in the straw. The old lock gives, and the cell door swings open.

property.name: hint
property.value: The bones in this wall are loose, as if something pushes from behind.

property.name: text
property.value: The bone wall slides aside. Something breathes beyond it.

property.name: text
property.value: The gears grind. The spikes sink into the floor - for now.

property.name: hint
property.value: A rusted gear. The spike pits are chained to it.

property.name: text
property.value: You kick the reading table over. Let them shoot at oak.

property.name: text
property.value: You kick the reading table over. Let them shoot at oak.
